# PowerPlay v1.1.0 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Set Continue Watching and Episode actions to **Open Details** by default.
- Enabled content-frame-rate matching and automatic intro skipping with a 3-second delay by default.
- Expanded PowerPlay branding through startup and About screens while preserving existing user preferences.
